title: I was Arrested by the US Army in Minecraft (April Fools)
description:
For april fools I wanted to do something special with the members and friends of the Wavetech server. So we got together and did a bit of roleplay as the US army in Minecraft where the goal was to arrest me for manufacturing weapons of mass destruction. I hope you enjoy.

Check out the Slimestone Archive where @MythicalPingu published his amazing flying machine replica of an A1 Abrams Battletank:
https://discord.gg/njpAkGb5tc

For this stunt we used the Simple Animated Gun Mod for Fabric:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-simple-animated-guns

Action sequence track was Meathook composed by Mick Gordon for the Doom Eternal OST

Wavetech Server Discord:
https://discord.gg/SR6q7sC

Mods that I use:
https://www.mediafire.com/file/rrtgqhxe7l04qc0/mods.zip/file
